{{Quote|Have you come to protect the Shock Drum like Master Kiwiiks?''"<br />"''What happened to her?''"<br />"''She defended us against Imperial soldiers led by a Sith. She fought bravely, but the Sith was stronger.|Hare'en and Kira Carsen|<ref name="The Shock Drum" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]'s personal [[Desolator crisis|war of vengeance]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], Angral's apprentice, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Praven]], '''attacked''' the [[Shock Drum facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with the support of a complement of [[Imperial soldier]]s. The facility, which hosted the Republic research team working on the [[Shock Drum]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], was defended by a host of [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]], and Kiwiiks defeated many of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] attackers before Praven engaged her in battle. The [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] defeated Kiwiiks in their [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] and destroyed the remaining security [[Droid/Legends|droids]] before departing the compound with the Shock Drum prototype and an unconscious Kiwiiks as his [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Last we heard, Kiwiiks secured our weapons research facility. She's missed every comm check since then.|General [[Var Suthra]]|<ref name="The Shock Drum" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis']] undercover mission as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] was threatened by the arrival of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Kira Carsen]], on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Abandoning his persona as a scientist working on the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], Tarnis led Republic security forces and several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on a [[Mission to Coruscant (Desolator crisis)|chase]] across the capital before attempting to use the stolen Planet Prison against Coruscant itself. However, Tarnis was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;the former apprentice of Jedi Master [[Orgus Din]]&mdash;before his plans could come to fruition. The Knight's [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|duel]] with Tarnis was witnessed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Darth Angral]].<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

Armed with information on the entire [[Republic superweapon initiative]] courtesy of his [[Gender/Legends|son]], a furious Angral proceeded to [[Desolator crisis|wage war]] on the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as revenge for his son's death. The elder Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] dispatched his three apprentices, [[Sadic]], [[Nefarid]], and [[Praven]], to take control of the Republic's three off-world weapons facilities.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> The [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] Praven traveled to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in order to seek the [[Shock Drum]] weapon. However, Kiwiiks had also come to Tatooine a short [[Time/Legends|time]] earlier,<ref name="The Shock Drum" /> as the Republic became aware of the vulnerability of its weapons facilities not long before Tarnis' death,<ref name="The Rescue">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Rescue|Coruscant}}</ref> and she arrived at the [[Shock Drum facility]] in the [[Northern Jundland Wastes]] before Praven and his complement of [[Imperial soldier]]s did.<ref name="The Shock Drum" />

==The attack==
{{Quote|I assumed he was going to kill us all. Instead, he captured Master Kiwiiks alive and ignored us.''"<br />"''Not ignoring! Scary man destroying Brrik's droids. Taking Brrik many hours rebuilding!|Hare'en and the Jawa [[Brrik]]|<ref name="The Shock Drum" />}}
[[File:Shock_Drum.png|thumb|right|260px|The Shock Drum, the target of Praven's forces]]
Before launching their attack on the facility, Praven's [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] took out the compound's [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], deactivating the exterior defenses. When the soldiers stormed the facility itself, the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] Jedi Master Kiwiiks single-handedly defeated many of them in an attempt to defend both the Shock Drum prototype and the project's research team, a [[seismologist]] named [[Hare'en]] and a [[Brrik's clan|clan]] of the planet's native [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]. Kiwiiks was supported by the compound's [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]], but the presence of Praven turned the tide in the Imperials' favor. The Sith Lord dispatched the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] defenders and engaged Kiwiiks in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], driving the older [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combatant]] onto the defensive. Kiwiiks held her own against Praven's assault for a short time, but their battle eventually ended when Praven knocked her unconscious and departed with his remaining soldiers, taking both the Jedi Master and the Shock Drum as his prizes.<ref name="The Shock Drum" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|She faced me as a warrior. She should die as one.|Praven, on his regret that he did not disobey Angral's orders|<ref name="The Shock Drum" />}}
Upon learning that Praven had captured the Jedi Master who had detected Tarnis on Coruscant, a vengeful Angral ordered his apprentice to leave Kiwiiks to die with the Shock Drum. He also ordered Praven to activate the superweapon and change the deactivation codes, ensuring that Tarnis's killer would fail regardless of whether they reached the Shock Drum or not. Despite his personal disgust for his Master's orders, as they violated Praven's strict code of honor, the Sith Lord complied with his instructions and left the Shock Drum beneath a [[Dune Sea mining complex|mining complex]] in Tatooine's [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] region.<ref name="Desert Duel">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Desert Duel|Tatooine}}</ref> With the Shock Drum Facility's defenses disabled, the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] began to raid the compound, forcing Hare'en and the Jawas to lock themselves in one of the facility's secure chambers. The Jedi Knight responsible for Tarnis's death soon arrived on Tatooine and [[Skirmish in the Shock Drum facility|cleared the compound]] of the Tusken Raiders, learning Kiwiiks's fate from Hare'en, and then set out to locate the stolen Shock Drum.<ref name="The Shock Drum" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Shock Drum Facility was mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Shock Drum" />
